purpose: Simultaneous regions side by side, two or three, each with its footage or its text.
accessibility: Each region is a column of the canvas safe area. Footage is muted (source audio is task 044), clipped to its region and framed by its fit; its alt text is kept in the IR and not drawn. A region's text is drawn in the theme's text colour in its own column and scales down within the type scale, so it never runs into a neighbour. Regions read left to right: left, middle, right.
